description: Use this when someone wants a weight-loss calorie target. Returns maintenance calories (TDEE) and up to three deficit tiers — mild (−250), standard (−500) and aggressive (−750 kcal/day) — each with the realistic weekly rate it buys, and a flag when a target dips below BMR. Needs age, sex, height, weight and activity; pass pregnancy or lactation when either applies. weight_loss_targets lists only the paces myplate.food itself offers: a pace whose target is under 1,200 kcal a day for women or 1,500 for men (the low end of the calorie prescriptions in the 2013 AHA/ACC/TOS obesity guideline) is left out and named, without a figure, in weight_loss_not_offered. weight_loss_default is the pace the calculator page opens on and weight_loss_floor_kcal is the floor that was applied. In pregnancy and while breastfeeding no targets are returned, and weight_loss_withheld gives the reason (pregnancy or lactation). Do not work out a lower target yourself when one is left out or withheld. Adult equations: ages 18 to 120. A younger age returns 400; for a child or teenager use myplate-plan or dri, whose energy equations have child forms.

activity.description: Physical activity level. Defaults to sedentary.

age.description: Age in years (18–120). These are adult equations; for a child or teenager use calculate_myplate_plan or calculate_dri.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

lactation.description: Breastfeeding status. Weight-loss figures are withheld while breastfeeding.

pregnancy.description: Pregnancy status. Weight-loss figures are withheld during pregnancy.

sex.description: Biological sex — drives the energy equation.

name: calculate_calorie_deficit
title: Calculate calorie-deficit tiers for weight loss
